content.user_title: Improve Claude Responses With Actionable Feedback
content.value_statement: AI responses can be correct yet still hard to apply or verify. This skill turns quality gaps into prioritized improvements with clear steps.
actual_capabilities: Identifies correctness, completeness, clarity, efficiency, security, and usability improvement areas.
Turns observed issues into specific changes with rationale and expected impact.
Prioritizes recommendations by urgency, cost, and user value.
Provides before and after examples for code, explanations, and solution plans.
Defines verification steps and success criteria for proposed improvements.
Suggests alternative approaches when trade-offs matter.
limitations: Does not execute code, run tests, or modify files by itself.
Depends on the quality of the supplied response, code, or analysis context.
Cannot prove performance, security, or correctness without external validation.
May need domain expert review for regulated or high-stakes work.

use_cases.title: Refine AI Responses
use_cases.description: Convert vague feedback into concrete edits, better structure, and clearer explanations.

use_cases.title: Improve Code Reviews
use_cases.description: Prioritize fixes for validation, error handling, maintainability, and security hardening.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Documentation
use_cases.description: Find missing context, weak examples, unclear steps, and verification gaps in technical writing.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Improvements
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single response
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this response and suggest three specific improvements. Explain the issue, the change, and why it helps.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these issues, rank the improvements by impact and urgency. Include implementation steps and verification criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Code Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Review code or a planned implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest improvements for this code. Focus on correctness, validation, error handling, maintainability, and security risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose two alternative improvements for this solution. Compare trade-offs, migration effort, risks, and testing strategy.

output_examples.input: A response explains async concepts with heavy jargon for beginners.
output: Issue: The explanation assumes prior knowledge of promises and event loops.
Improvement: Start with a simple real-world analogy, then introduce the technical terms.
Verification: Ask a beginner to restate the concept and identify where waiting occurs.

output_examples.input: A code review finds a login query built from user input.
output: Priority: Critical because user input reaches a database query.
Improvement: Use parameterized queries and add tests with malicious input examples.
Success criteria: Normal login still works and injection-style input does not alter query behavior.

output_examples.input: A project plan lists tasks but lacks validation steps.
output: Issue: The plan does not define how the team will know each task is complete.
Improvement: Add success criteria, owner, evidence, and rollback notes for each major task.
Trade-off: This adds planning time but reduces rework during delivery.

best_practices: Provide the original response, code, or plan so suggestions can cite concrete issues.
Ask for priorities when time, risk, or implementation effort matters.
Request verification criteria so each improvement can be tested or reviewed.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for general polish without naming the target audience or goal.
Do not accept large rewrites without checking the reason for each change.
Do not treat suggestions as proven fixes until they are tested or reviewed.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves AI responses, code examples, explanations, documentation, plans, and solution designs.

faq.question: Does it make changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends concrete changes, priorities, examples, and verification steps.

faq.question: Can it review code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest improvements for validation, error handling, maintainability, performance, and security.

faq.question: Can it replace testing?
faq.answer: No. It can propose tests and success criteria, but actual verification must be performed separately.

faq.question: How should I get the best results?
faq.answer: Include the target audience, the current output, known issues, and any constraints.

faq.question: Is it useful outside coding?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve explanations, documentation, communication, project plans, and product workflows.
